final.role: .NET full-text search library to build the hub's keyword index if the hub runs on .NET.
final.evidence: Apache Lucene.NET is an open-source full-text search library written in C#; 4.8 (still in Beta) runs everywhere .NET runs, including Windows.

conferencia.nota: Biblioteca C# de busca full-text, roda no Windows; so serve se o hub for escrito em .NET, e a versao 4.8 ainda esta em beta.
